fa.indexRule: A from 0xD0058E, valid while A < 0x44, then 2-byte lookup

fb.indexRule: A from 0xD0058E, if A >= 0x8C then A -= 0x7F, then 2-byte lookup

fe.indexRule: If A < 0x69 use direct 1-byte lookup at 0x05C01D, else A -= 0x69 and switch to 0x05C086

continuationTable.note: If A >= 0x69, ConvKeyToTok subtracts 0x69 and switches to a 2-byte table at 0x05C086.
